instructions: Player-facing prose: Jam owns data/player-copy.json; keep board in sync on Save.

items.ability: Atk 3, or Atk 1 and Keep this item
items.name: Throwing Knife

items.ability: Gain 4 Block.
items.name: Shield

items.ability: Starts at 2 each fight. Flips 2 ↔ 4 after any Item is used.
items.name: Sai
items.notes: This should NOT start at 2 each fight, it should carry over its value between combats (not between dungeons eg adventure mode)

items.ability: Block equal to the HP you are missing.
items.name: Medallion

items.ability: Block equal to whoever has less HP — you or the enemy.
items.explainer: (the lower of YOUR HP and ENEMY HP)
items.flow: Lower HP wins; player value if tied. Recheck on HP change either side.
items.name: Helmet

items.ability: Defeat an enemy with less HP than you. Combat ends immediately.
items.flow: When used, Resolve Combat immediately, skipping ATK/BLK resolution.
items.name: The Boot

items.ability: +1 ATK for each HP you are missing.
items.name: Bloody Gauntlets

items.ability: Block equal to the weaker Neighboring enemy's Attack.
items.name: Bracers

items.ability: Attack equal to 8 minus the Items still in your hand.
items.flow: Also describes HP Delta (absolute difference of player vs enemy HP).
items.name: Knucklers

items.ability: Gets stronger. +2 Attack each time you lose any HP.
items.name: Spiked Flail

items.ability: Defeat an enemy with 5 or more Attack. Combat ends immediately.
items.flow: When used, Resolve Combat immediately, skipping ATK/BLK resolution.
items.name: Sledgehammer

items.ability: Attack equal to the Attack of the last monster you faced.
items.flow: On Spin, store enemy ATK. Initial value is always 0.
items.name: Grimoire

items.ability: Gain 2 Block. If you lose HP this combat, Keep this Item.
items.flow: Tap on use. Discard on resolve unless HP dropped vs On Spin. Healing Potion this combat makes Did Lose HP always True.
items.name: Breastplate

items.ability: Spin again and gain a Random Item.
items.flow: End combat without resolving. Spin again, not the same slice. Draw 1 unseen item, tier-agnostic.
items.name: Smoke Bomb

items.ability: Take their hit (Block still works), Defeat them, then Heal equal to the HP they had.
items.explainer: (TAKE THEIR ATK) then Defeat then Heal THEIR HP
items.flow: Store enemy HP on use. Fangs DMG can be blocked like Resolve Combat. Then heal stored HP. Player HP never exceeds 6. If this would kill you: Healing Potion, then Fangs Healing.
items.name: Fangs

items.ability: Mark a Neighbor. When you spin them, they lose 5 HP immediately.
items.flow: Lose HP is not ATK dmg (can kill Goblin). Unusable with 0 neighbors. Crossbow-marked neighbors are not choosable.
items.name: Poison Flask

items.ability: Unplayable. If you would die, discard this and Heal 3.
items.flow: If player HP ever equals 0, immediately Discard this item and set the player's HP to 4.
items.name: Healing Potion

items.ability: Deal 4 Attack to a Neighboring enemy with 4 HP or less.
items.flow: On use, choose a neighboring enemy with 4 or less HP. Deal 4 attack damage to them. If their HP reaches 0, they are defeated immediately. Goblin cannot receive ATK damage. Unusable with 0 eligible neighbors.
items.name: Crossbow

items.ability: Attack equal to the Attack of the strongest Neighboring enemy.
items.name: Pocketwatch

items.ability: Deal 2 Attack to the Owner you are facing and each Neighboring Owner. The same Owner is only hit once.
items.flow: On use, deal 2 ATK to the facing owner and each unique living neighbor. Two owners left: the other takes 2 once. Goblin ignores ATK. Used up.
items.name: Double Axe

items.ability: Heal 1, plus 1 for each monster Defeated
items.flow: On use in a fight, heal 1 + mobs_defeated, cap at 6 HP. Used up. Healing Potion still revives on death.
items.name: Victory Flask

items.ability: Swap a Neighboring Owner into this fight. Draw a Random Item.
items.flow: On use, pick a living neighbor. Swap that owner with the facing owner. Keep current block, items-used, and snapshots. Draw one item from the remaining pool if any. Used up.
items.name: Grappling Hook

items.ability: Deal 2 Attack, or gain 2 Block.
items.flow: On use, choose ATK 2 or BLK 2. Used up either way.
items.name: Spiked Shield
items.notes: Art is a stand-in until a spiked shield tile exists.

items.ability: Each time you Spin, Lose 1 HP and this item gains +2 Block
items.explainer: On Spin: Lose 1 HP, this Gains 2 Block
items.flow: While in hand and not spent: at combat start, player loses 1 HP (counts as a bleed for Spiked Flail) and this card's block number +2. On use, gain that much block, then used up. Starts at 0.
items.name: Grief Jar

items.ability: Deal 4 Attack to the monster across from you (only works if even # of monsters remaining)
items.flow: Usable in a fight only when living slice count is even. Deal 4 ATK to the opposite slice. Goblin ignores ATK. Odd count: cannot use. Used up.
items.name: Longbow

items.ability: Heal 2. Keep this if you are still missing HP.
items.flow: Click during a fight. Heal 2, cap 6. If HP is still below 6, keep the card. If you are already at 6, heal 0 and the card is used up. Counts as an item use.
items.name: Lantern
items.notes: Breastplate keeps if you bled. This keeps if you are still hurt after the heal.
items.review_note: (Tier 3) - Heal 2, then Keep this if you are still missing HP.

items.ability: Gain Block equal to the last Block you gained.
items.flow: Click during a fight. Gain Block equal to the last Block you gained this dungeon. If you have not gained Block yet this dungeon, the click does nothing and the card stays. Used up. Counts as an item use.
items.name: Mirror Shard
items.notes: Last Block is the amount from the last time you gained Block, not your current Block total.
items.review_note: (Tier 2) Gains block equal to the last Block you've gained. Tier 2

items.ability: Becomes a copy of the last item you used.
items.flow: In hand this looks like the last item you used this dungeon (faint Echo icon). Click it to use that copy, then Echo is used up even if the original had Keep. If you have not used an item this dungeon, it is Unplayable.
items.name: Echo Bell
items.notes: Updates when you use an item. Cube feed is not an item use. First fight of a run: Unplayable.
items.review_note: (Tier 3) Becomes a copy of the last item you used. (updates on item use, but keeps the echo bell icon faintly in the top right of the card).

items.ability: Remove the facing owner's unique ability.
items.flow: Click during a fight. That owner id loses its unique ability and formulas for the rest of this dungeon. They show printed ATK/HP like Golem. If they have no unique ability, the click does nothing and the card stays. Used up otherwise.
items.name: Quiet Bell
items.notes: Golem: cannot click. Bandit and other formulas fall back to the ATK/HP columns.
items.review_note:
(Tier 2) Remove the unique ability of the enemy.

(The enemy UI literally removes the text of their ability, and will pretend that it is an abiity-free unit (eg Golem) with the base stats of the unit. This means units with formula stats like Bandit simply turn into their base stats and are badly nerfed by this)

items.ability: Reduce the facing owner's Attack by 1, 2, or 3.
items.flow: Click during a fight, then click 1, 2, or 3. Facing Attack drops by that much after every other formula including Commander, floors at 0, then locks for the rest of this fight. Used up.
items.name: Net
items.notes: Caltrops is retired. This is the milder version, last in calc.

items.ability: Deal Attack equal to Block you hold. Keep this item.
items.flow: Click during a fight. Deal Attack equal to Block you hold. You keep that Block. This item Keeps. Unplayable at 0 Block. Counts as an item use. Goblin cannot take Attack damage.
items.name: Chain
items.notes: Hornet and Queen still Attack after. You still hold the Block for those swings.
items.review_note: Attack equal to your Block, then Keep this item.

items.flow: Click during a fight. Deal Attack equal to the dungeon cycle number (1, then 2, then 3, then 4, then 1). Every item use this dungeon advances that number, including this click. The cycle carries across fights and resets on the next dungeon. Two Beads share one number. Used up. Counts as an item use. Goblin cannot take Attack damage.
items.name: Counting Beads
items.notes: Cube feed is not an item use, so the cycle does not advance. Anvil takes 1 from this Attack.
items.review_note: Alternates from 1, 2, 3, and 4 Atk damage on Item use.

items.ability: If you have zero items that deal Attack, Defeat them.
items.flow: Click during a fight. If you hold no items that deal Attack, Defeat them. This card is not an Attack item. Unplayable if any other card in hand deals Attack. Used up when it works. Counts as an item use. Gargoyle cannot be Defeated.
items.name: Paci Fist
items.notes: Holding only this works. Echo copying an Attack item counts as an Attack item. Shield alone is enough.
items.review_note:
(Change name to 'Paci-Fist', and icon to an open palm strike)
If you have zero items that deal Atk damage, Defeat the enemy.

items.ability: Deal Attack equal to half your HP (rounded down) and Heal that much. If they survive, Keep this item.
items.explainer: (Attack = half HP. Heal that much. Survive: Keep.)
items.flow: Click during a fight. Deal Attack equal to half your current HP, rounded down. Heal that same number even if they die. If they still have HP after that Attack, including Goblin, Keep this item. If they die, this is used up. Counts as an item use.
items.name: Scythe
items.notes: Goblin takes 0 Attack and still has HP, so Keep. Heal still happens if they die. Anvil takes 1 from this Attack. Ogre HP is your HP, so half your HP cannot kill them by itself.
items.review_note: Attack equal to half your HP (rounded down) and Heal that much. If the enemy survives, Keep this item.

items.ability: Choose other items in your hand. Each becomes a random item of that item's tier.
items.flow: Click during a fight, then click other items in your hand. If you hold only one other item, reroll that one. If you hold two or more, pick two. Each becomes a random item of that item's tier, with the same motion as Adventure Mode starter upgrades. This card cannot target itself. Unplayable if this is the only item in your hand. Used up. Counts as an item use.
items.name: Chaos Stone
items.notes: Does not deal Attack. Gargoyle petrify does not pick this. Cube feed is not this.
items.review_note:
(Change to 'Chaos Stone')

Choose 2 Items and replace them with random Items of the same Tier.

(This should have a similar transformation animation to how Adventure Mode dungeon starters are 'upgraded' in Tier.

items.ability: At the start of each combat, lose 1 HP. On use, Heal your HP to up to full (6).
items.flow: While in inventory unused, Lose 1 HP On Spin after combat has begun. Counts as Did Lose HP for Breastplate.
items.name: Cursed Scroll

items.ability: The facing owner's Attack becomes 0 this fight.
items.flow: Click during a fight. Set facing Attack to 0 and lock it for the rest of this fight, including after Commander and Harpy formulas. They still leave after Done. Used up.
items.name: Caltrops
items.notes: Dragon pierce of 0 is 0. Kobold still swings twice for 0.

items.ability: (ATK 2), then return to your hand.
items.flow: Do not discard on use; Tap. Untap always occurs On Resolve Combat.
items.name: Dagger

items.ability: (BLK X), where X is the lowest HP between you and the enemy.
items.flow: Older check: only enemy HP change, not player HP. Hidden/retired.
items.name: Helmet

items.ability: At the start of each combat, lose 1 HP.
items.name: Bandana

monsters.ability: My spellbook was in that pile.
monsters.name: Wizard

monsters.ability: My stone fists want that back.
monsters.name: Golem

monsters.ability: I cannot take Attack damage.
monsters.flow: This unit's HP can never be reduced. Note that this unit can be defeated through all other means.
monsters.name: Goblin

monsters.ability: I copy the HP of the last enemy you faced.
monsters.flow: On Spin, immediately store the enemy's HP in this value. Overwrite each On Spin.
monsters.name: Skeleton
monsters.notes: If this is the first unit faced, set HP to 3.

monsters.ability: I Attack twice.
monsters.flow: On Resolve Combat, takes its current ATK and deals dmg to the player two times. There should be no special or unique interaction with BLK, this should attack in a logically consistent way to if two enemies simply attacked the player, one after the other. For example, the player may actually BLEED twice if both attacks cause the player to lose health.
monsters.name: Hornet Swarm

monsters.ability: I give my Neighbors +1 HP.
monsters.flow: Set each neighbor's HP to its (Max HP + 1).
monsters.name: Lich

monsters.ability: My HP is your HP.
monsters.name: Ogre

monsters.ability: I gain one HP and Attack with each monster you Defeat.
monsters.flow: Every time a slice is removed after the initial drafting phase, this increments.
monsters.name: Berserker

monsters.ability: My Attack is your HP.
monsters.name: Dire Wolf

monsters.ability: +1 Atk for each Item you hold.
monsters.name: Bandit

monsters.ability: My Attack drops to 0 if you use two Items this fight.
monsters.flow: When player taps 2 items this combat, ATK immediately drops to 0.
monsters.name: Two-Headed Serpent
monsters.notes: If the second item is Smoke Bomb, nothing special. Smoke Bomb happens; when Serpent is spun again later it attacks again.

monsters.ability: My Attack always equals my HP.
monsters.name: Slime Boss
monsters.notes: Only unit whose ATK can change mid-combat. Damaging it affects Sai, Fangs, Sledgehammer.

monsters.ability: My HP equals the number of monsters in play
monsters.name: Leech League
monsters.review_note:
(Rework) - On Spin, this unit gives +1 HP to another unit with the Lowest HP still  in the dungeon. Then it gives itself +1 HP)

(Calculates HP after other On Spin effects. If multiple candidates, choose one at random . This needs an animation and sound effect highlighting the Leech League granting 1 HP to the selected monster. The 'other monster' cannot ever be itself, so if Leech League is alone it will only grant itself +1 HP)

monsters.ability: I copy the higher ATK of my Neighbors
monsters.flow: Resolve order: the only function whose order of operations matters. Match higher neighbor ATK (with their complete modifiers), then receive the ATK increase from Captain.
monsters.name: Wraith

monsters.ability: If I go down before I Attack, you gain an Item.
monsters.flow: Did It Attack? starts False. Set True if the enemy ever attacks. Prevent by killing or defeating with items (not blocking). Draw 1 unseen item, tier-agnostic. If pool empty, draw nothing.
monsters.name: Mimic

monsters.ability: I Attack twice if a Neighbor has less HP than I do.
monsters.explainer: double hit if a Neighbor is weaker
monsters.flow: Each On Enemy HP Change, if any neighbor has less HP, set times_attack to 2.
monsters.name: Spider Queen

monsters.ability: I give my Neighbors +2 Attack.
monsters.flow: Set each neighbor ATK to Base ATK + 1.
monsters.name: Commander

monsters.ability: My Attack ignores Block.
monsters.name: Dragon

monsters.ability: I Attack you for 1 dmg each time I take ATK damage.
monsters.flow: ATK 3, HP 5. Each time this owner receives ATK damage (including a killing blow), the player takes 1 ATK; block applies. Defeat and poison do not poke. Goblin-style immunity does not apply to this owner.
monsters.name: Needleback
monsters.notes: Portrait is a 0x72 wogol stand-in until a porcupine/toad tile exists.

monsters.ability: I make you feed me one of two items.
monsters.flow: On spin, if you have 0 items, nothing. If 1, you must feed that one. If 2 or more, two random items are offered and you must feed one. The discard is not an item use. ATK/HP unchanged.
monsters.name: Gelatinous Cube
monsters.notes: Not an item use: no Kobold extra, no Echo update, no Harpy after the feed.
monsters.review_note: At the start of combat, selects 2 random items and forces the user to 'feed' them one, discarding it with no effect. (Maybe with a fun dialogue pop-up as it mocks the player and thanks the player for feeding them)

monsters.ability: I petrify your highest Attack item until you Spin again.
monsters.flow: After spin numbers, the highest Attack item in hand becomes Unplayable until the next Spin. Tie is random. No Attack items: nothing. Longbow and Spiked Shield count. Boot and Poison Flask do not. Smoke is a new Spin, so it clears. Attack still works. Cannot be Defeated unless Quiet Bell has silenced me.
monsters.name: Gargoyle
monsters.notes: Petrify tooltip: Unplayable until your next Spin.
monsters.review_note:
(Tier 2) At the start of combat, 'Petrifies' your Item with the highest ATK value

(Waits until after on-spin calculations are finished, then creates a 'stone petrification' texture/overlay on the item with the highest current ATK, making it Unplayable until the fight is over. A tooltip popup should appear when the user holds shift and is reading this ability to define 'Petrify' and explain this mechanic with, "Petrify - becomes Unplayable until your next Spin".

When calculating Atk to choose a target, formula count. If there's a tie, choose at random. If there are no items that deal atk damage, this ability does nothing. Any item that has Atk counts, including things like Longbow and Spiked SHield (but not things like Da Boot and Poison Flask)

monsters.ability: I attack you when we meet, and after each item you use.
monsters.flow: On spin, one swing of my current Attack (Block works). After each item fully resolves, if I am still alive, one more swing. Ceases when you click Done or I am Defeated/Slain. Done still takes the normal hit. Not Attack = Block.
monsters.name: Harpy
monsters.notes: One swing, fight stays open. If an item already killed me, no extra swing.
monsters.review_note: At the start of combat, and after the player uses any item, if the Harpy is not already defeated, it will immediately resolve combat by attacking the player. Only after the player clicks 'Done (Take X)' or Defeats/Slays the Harpy will this ability cease

monsters.ability: I attack an extra time for each item you use this fight.
monsters.flow: On Done, swing count is 1 plus items used this fight. Cube feed does not count. Block is spent per swing.
monsters.name: Kobold Trapper
monsters.review_note: (Tier 2) Attacks an additional time for each item you use during this fight.

monsters.ability: If I live, I leave two Tier 2 owners in my place.
monsters.flow: If you do not Defeat or Slay me, I leave and two random Tier 2 owners sit immediately, even if that grows the wheel past 8. You are not in a new fight yet.
monsters.name: Clockwork Knight
monsters.notes: Quiet Bell strips this: I leave like anyone else, no heirs.
monsters.review_note: (If the player does not Defeat or Slay this monster, it will remove itself from the dungeon and replace itself with 2 Tier 2 Monsters chosen randomly)

monsters.ability: I discard all items you use immediately while you face me.
monsters.flow: While you fight me, Keep does not work. Every item you use is discarded immediately. Knife nick, Lantern, and Breastplate leave your hand. Quiet Bell strips this.
monsters.name: Basilisk
monsters.notes: Keep after the fight is already over does not apply — the toss happens when you click.
monsters.review_note:
Slight rewording, but same ability,

"While facing me, all Items are discarded upon use immediately."

monsters.ability: Even Attack and even Block happen twice against me.
monsters.flow: While you fight me, an even Attack number hits me twice as two separate Attacks of that number. An even Block you gain while facing me is gained twice. Odd numbers happen once. Quiet Bell strips this.
monsters.name: Twins
monsters.notes: Anvil would take 1 from each of those two Attacks. Poison Flask is not an Attack.
monsters.review_note:
Change to 'Twins' and replace art with two twin or dopples)

Attack or Block values that are Even happen twice against me.

(Eg if the player uses a weapon that has 2 Attack, it 'attacks twice' and deals 4 total damage against this unit. Similarly, if the player blocks for 4, it will add 4 Block twice for 8 total block.

monsters.ability: My Attack copies the Attack number on your leftmost Attack item. If you have none, my Attack is 3.
monsters.flow: My Attack is the live Attack number on your leftmost item that has an Attack number, after the usual hand sort, skipping cards with no Attack number. It updates on Spin and when you use an item. If you have no such item, my Attack is 3. Quiet Bell: printed Attack.
monsters.name: Beggar
monsters.notes: Spent cards are skipped. Petrified cards have no Attack number for this.
monsters.review_note: Replaces its Attack to always equal to the current Attack value of the player's leftmost item (that has an Attack value). Updates this value upon Spin and Item use. If the player has zero such items, then its Attack returns to its base value of 3.

monsters.ability: I gain 1 Attack and lose 1 HP whenever you use an item.
monsters.atk_formula: printed Attack, plus item uses on the wheel
monsters.flow: Whenever you use an item, every Wick on the wheel gains 1 Attack and loses 1 HP immediately, even if you are not facing them. A Wick at 0 HP is not removed until the fight you are in ends. If you are facing a Wick at 0 HP, they do not Attack; Done removes them as Slain. Cube feed is not an item use. Quiet Bell strips this.
monsters.name: Wick
monsters.notes: Kobold adds extra swings. I add to the Attack number. Both can stack if they ever sat together; they will not in one fight.
monsters.review_note:
Gains +1 Atk and loses 1 HP each time the player uses an item.

Health up0dates immediately upon Item use (regardless of who the player is actively facing), but if the unit drops to 0 HP they will not be Slain until after the current combat is Done

monsters.ability: I cannot lose more than 1 HP from one source.
monsters.flow: I cannot lose more than 1 HP from one source. Attack, Poison Flask, and other HP loss each chip 1. Defeat still works. Two separate Attacks chip 1 twice. Quiet Bell strips this, so full Attack lands.
monsters.name: Anvil
monsters.notes: Needleback poke is not an Item hitting me. Poison Flask is not an Attack. Extra Attacks each chip 1.
monsters.review_note:
I cannot lose more than 1 HP at a time (from any source).

(Can still be 'defeated', but effects like Poison Flask, Attack Damage, etc. can only reduce its HP by 1 at a time. Notably, things that trigger attacks multiple times would proc this ability twice, making the unit lose 2 total HP for example)
